summary: Atossa Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing its board approved issuing one stapled contingent value right (CVR) per common share, letting holders share in 25% of net proceeds from monetization of the company's first qualifying rare pediatric disease priority review voucher, capped at $50 million aggregate. Record-date holders and subsequently issued shares would receive CVRs. Two FDA rare pediatric disease designations exist for (Z)-endoxifen, in Duchenne muscular dystrophy and McCune-Albright syndrome. The board recommends the plan; no advisor named. Terms and mechanics remain skeletal, watching for the CVR agreement, record date, and voucher-trigger risk.
